{{Top|leg}}
Developed for use by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], the '''mesh trap''' was a weave of electrified fibers that could be placed on the ground and camouflaged. When the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] stepped onto the trap, a surge of electricity was triggered and the being was [[Stun/Legends|stunned]] for a few moments, giving the bounty hunter an opportunity to easily capture their quarry.
